notes: Pin-Bot visor sequence probe from the retained initialized NVRAM: with the visor motor relay (13) running after power-up, Visor Closed (46) is closed for 4 s and opened, then Visor Open (47) is closed for 4 s and opened, then 46 is closed again and held. Records which switch edge stops the motor and what the ROM fires when it does. Auto-Up (-6 = 1) held from start; the harness never moves the visor itself.

actions.label: visor motor running, no visor switch closed
Visor Closed (46) closes while the motor runs
Visor Closed (46) closes again and stays closed
